- If authentication fails for CEO: allow ID verification via shared secure Zoom session with Redwood CSO (rare; last-resort).

Karthik — can you confirm the envelope will include auto-upload of executed PDF to the Brightwell folder and that audit logs will be attached to the Drive copy? Also, please add the HubSpot deal id in the envelope metadata.
